claims.text: ABは平豆で、18を通過し16に残る(6.35mm)

claims.text: PBは、1つの胚珠だけが育った豆で、17を通過し12に残る(4.76mm)

claims.location: Crops (Coffee) (General) Regulations 2019, Fifth Schedule A. Kenya Standards(STANDARD COFFEE GRADES)

claims.location: Crops (Coffee) (General) Regulations 2019, Fifth Schedule A. Kenya Standards(STANDARD COFFEE GRADES)

claims.text: 等級を指定する場合、95%以上の豆が、その等級の範囲に入ること
claims.quote: Where a coffee grade is specified a minimum 95% of beans shall fall in that grade category.
claims.location: Crops (Coffee) (General) Regulations 2019, Fifth Schedule A. Kenya Standards(STANDARD COFFEE GRADES)

claims.text: 東アフリカ規格は、大きさと形による格付けは、品質のおおよその目安にすぎないと述べる

claims.text: Premium grade: 傷・割れ・黒い豆・緩んだ豆の無い、白っぽいパーチメント
claims.quote: (1) Premium grade; which shall mean parchment whitish parchment coffee with no damaged, broken, black pods or loose beans.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 1

claims.text: Parchment I: 中央の切れ目がわずかに開いた、白っぽいパーチメント(機械で割れたものが少しある)
claims.quote: (2) Parchment I; which shall mean whitish parchment coffee with centre cuts slightly opened or with few parchments broken by machine.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 2

claims.text: Parchment II: 茶色っぽい、まずまずの品質のパーチメントで、中央の切れ目が開いている
claims.quote: (3) Parchment II; which shall mean a fair quality parchment coffee with brownish parchment with centre cuts opened.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 3

claims.text: Parchment III: 茶色から黒い豆で、機械で割れた豆が多く、浮き豆・変色したパーチメント・黒い豆がある
claims.quote: (4) Parchment III; which shall mean parchment coffee, brownish to black skinned beans, with much more beans broken by machine, presence of floats, discoloured parchment and black beans.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 4

claims.text: Estate clean: 国内で脱穀した、緑がかった色の豆で、選別・格付け・磨きだけが必要なもの
claims.quote: (5) Estate clean; which shall mean domestically hulled coffee greenish in colour and requiring cleaning, grading and polishing only
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 5

claims.text: AA: スクリーン18に最低90%、17は最大8〜10%、15は最大2%
claims.quote: AA Retained minimum 90% of screen 18. Maximum 8 - 10% of screen 17 Maximum 2% of screen 15
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 2.0

claims.text: A: スクリーン15/16に最低90%、14は最大2%
claims.quote: A Retained minimum 90% of screen 15/16 Maximum 2% of screen 14
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 2.0

claims.text: PB: ピーベリーが最低95%、浮き豆は最大5%
claims.quote: PB Retained minimum 95% pea-berry beans 14 Maximum 5% float beans
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 2.0

claims.text: Fは、上記の等級から出た、軽い砕け豆
claims.quote: F Light broken beaiis resulting from all above grades
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule II. 2.0
claims.note: PDFの文字抽出で「beaiis」と崩れている(原文は「beans」)。

claims.text: Robusta over screen 18: スクリーン18を通過するのは、重量で5%以下
claims.quote: GRADE: ROBUSTA OVER SCREEN 18 Consist of clean and dry coffee beans of which not more than five percent (5%) by weight will pass through screen 18.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 1

claims.text: Superior: スクリーン16を通過するのは、重量で5%以下。欠点は15点以内
claims.quote: a. To consist of clean and dry coffee beans of which not more than 5% by weight will pass through Screen No. 16.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 2

claims.text: Superior: 欠点の点数は15点以内(半黒豆・虫害豆で3g=300gの1%)
claims.quote: to have defective points count of not more than 15, which is 3 grams of defects (semi-blacks and insect damaged) or 1% from 300 grams.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 2

claims.text: FAQ: 欠点の点数は40点以内
claims.quote: to have defective points count of not more than 40
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 3

claims.text: Special UG: 欠点の点数は60点以内
claims.quote: to have defects points count of not more than 60
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 4

claims.text: UG: 欠点の点数は160点以内で、うち黒豆は60点以内
claims.quote: to have defect the points count of not more than 160 of which not more than 60 points be attributable to black beans.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 5
claims.note: PDFの文字抽出で「defect the points count」と語順が崩れている。

claims.text: Triage: 殻は重量で1%以下
claims.quote: GRADE: ROBUSTA TRIAGE To consist of clean and dry coffee beans free from all traces of mustiness to contain not more than 1% weight of husks
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. 6

claims.text: 欠点の点数は、加工した豆300gの欠点を数えて、点数表で合計したもの
claims.quote: Defectives points count means the sum of points computed according to the scale detailed hereunder of point’s value for defectives by strict count of the defectives in 300 grams of processed coffee.
claims.location: Coffee Industry Regulations 2013 (GN 385), Sixth Schedule I. Defectives

origin:タンザニア:gradeSystem.note: 等級の詳細(2026-11-10)。公式文書の原文を読んで書いた。

claims.text: 分類は、カテゴリ・サブカテゴリ・グループ・サブグループ・クラス・タイプで行い、それぞれ、種、豆の形と粒度、香りと味、飲み物(カップ)、色、品質による
claims.quote: o Café Beneficiado Grão Cru será classificado em CATEGORIA, SUBCATEGORIA, GRUPO, SUBGRUPO, CLASSE e TIPO, segundo a espécie, formato do grão e a granulometria, o aroma e o sabor, a bebida, a cor e a qualidade, respectivamente.

claims.text: カテゴリ1はCoffea arabica、カテゴリIIはCoffea canephora
claims.quote: 4.1.1. Categoria 1: café proveniente da espécie Coffea arabica; 4.1.2. Categoria II: café proveniente da espécie Coffea canephora.

claims.text: Chato(平豆)は、ふるい19/18と17がグラウド、16と15がミディオ、14以下がミウド
claims.quote: 4.2.1.1.1. Chato graúdo: peneiras 19/18 e 17; 4.2.1.1.2. Chato médio: peneiras 16 e 15; 4.2.1.1.3. Chato miúdo: peneira 14 e menores.

claims.text: Moca(丸豆)は、ふるい13/12と11がグラウド、10がミディオ、9以下がミウド
claims.quote: 4.2.2.1.1. Moca graúdo: peneiras 13/12 e 11; 4.2.2.1.2. Moca médio: peneira 10; 4.2.2.1.3. Moca miúdo (moquinha): peneira 9 e menores.

claims.text: ふるいを分けていない場合、または4つ以上のふるいにまたがる場合は、Bica corrida
claims.quote: Quando o Café Beneficiado Grão Cru não for sub-metido à separação em peneiras, ou quando submetido se enquadre em quatro ou mais peneiras, será considerado BICA CORRIDA (B/C).

claims.text: ふるいごとの漏れ(下に抜ける量)は、最大10%まで
claims.quote: o vazamento máximo admissível para cada peneira será de 10%

claims.text: アラビカの上質なカップ: Estritamente mole(moleの要件をすべて満たし、より際立つ)、Mole(心地よく、穏やかで甘い)、Apenas mole(ほのかに甘く柔らかいが、渋みや粗さがない)、Duro(酸っぱく、渋く、粗いが、変な味はない)
claims.quote: 4.4.1.1. Estritamente mole: café que apresenta, em conjunto, todos os requisitos de aroma e sabor "mole", porém mais acentuado; || 4.4.1.2. Mole: café que apresenta aroma e sabor agradável, brando e adocicado; 4.4.1.3. Apenas mole: café que apresenta sabor levemente doce e suave, mas sem adstringência ou aspereza de paladar; 4.4.1.4. Duro: café que apresenta sabor acre, adstringente e áspero, porém não apresenta paladares estranhos.

claims.text: ヨードホルム臭系: Riado(わずか)、Rio(顕著)、Rio Zona(非常に強く、不快)
claims.quote: 4.4.2.1. Riado: café que apresenta leve sabor, típico de iodofórmio; 4.4 2.2. Rio: café que apresenta sabor típico e acentuado de iodofórmio; 4.4.2.3. Rio Zona: café que apresenta aroma e sabor muito acentuado, assemelhado ao iodofórmio ou ao ácido fênico, sendo repugnante ao paladar.

claims.text: ロブスタの飲み物: Excelente、Boa、Regular、Anormal
claims.quote: 4.4.3.1. Excelente: café que apresenta sabor neutro e acidez mediana; 4.4.3.2. Boa: café que apresenta sabor neutro e ligeira acidez; 4.4.3.3. Regular: café que apresenta sabor típico de robusta sem acidez; 4.4.3.4. Anormal: café que apresenta sabor não característico ao produto.

claims.text: クラス(色)は8つ: Verde azulado / Verde cana、Verde、Amarelada、Amarela、Marrom、Chumbado、Esbranquiçada、Discrepante
claims.quote: será classificado em 8 (oito) classes: 4.5.1. Verde Azulado e Verde Cana: cores características do café despolpado ou degomado;
claims.note: 8つのクラスの名前は、4.5.1〜4.5.8に並ぶ。引用は、冒頭の部分。

claims.text: 欠点の換算: 黒豆1個=1、発酵豆2個=1、貝殻豆3個=1、未熟(緑)豆5個=1、割れ5個=1、虫食い2〜5個=1、未熟な(中身の少ない)豆5個=1
claims.quote: Grão Preto 1 1 Grãos Ardidos 2 1 Conchas 3 1 Grãos Verdes 5 1 Grãos Quebrados 5 1 Grãos Brocados 2 a 5 1 Grãos Mal Granados ou Chochos 5 1

claims.text: タイプ2は欠点4個(+100点)
claims.note: 縦に並んだ表(欠点・タイプ・点数)の行。

claims.text: タイプ3は欠点12個(+50点)
タイプ4は欠点26個(基準)
claims.quote: 26 4 Base

claims.text: タイプ5は欠点46個(50点)
タイプ6は欠点86個(100点)
タイプ7は欠点160個(150点)
タイプ8は欠点360個(200点)。360個を超えると、規格外(Fora de Tipo)
claims.quote: 360 8 200 > 360 Fora de Tipo

claims.text: 黒豆が50個を超える、発酵豆が100個を超える、黒緑豆が100個を超えると、規格外
claims.quote: 7.2. Mais de 50 grãos pretos ou mais de 100 grãos ardidos ou mais de 100 grãos preto verde;

claims.text: 水分は、等級に関わらず、12.5%を超えてはならない
claims.quote: os teores de umidade do Café Beneficiado Grão Cru não poderão exceder os limites máximos de tolerância de 12,5%

claims.text: 異物・不純物は、最大1%
claims.quote: O percentual máximo de matérias estranhas e impurezas permitido no Café Beneficiado Grão Cru será de 1%

claims.text: この規則に反して生豆(Café Beneficiado Grão Cru)を商業化することは、詐欺とみなされる
claims.quote: 14.2. Será também considerada fraude a comercialização do Café Beneficiado Grão Cru, em desacordo com o estabelecido neste Regulamento.

claims.text: ブラジルの公式分類(COB)がある
claims.quote: nova tabela de Classificação Oficial Brasileira (COB) do café, elaborada pelo Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária (MAPA)

claims.text: Grado 1: 現在の収穫の豆で、色と大きさが均一、強く新鮮な香り
claims.quote: Compuesto por granos de cosecha actual, color y tamaño homogéneo y de olor intensamente fresco.

claims.text: Grado 1のカップは優秀で、酸味は高く、ボディは良好

claims.text: Grado 2: 現在の収穫の豆で、色が均一、新鮮な香り

claims.text: Grado 2のカップは良く、酸味は良好、ボディは中程度
